[ffff64]Labilans Sector[ffffff]
This is the place in Eldenbaum where only\nnon-human creatures reside.
A rule to prevent humans from invading their\nhabitat has existed since a long time ago even\nbefore the catastrophe.
Humans must only walk along the stone path...
Are you saying that they coexist with monsters?
Yup. The monsters here have been around long\nbefore humans...
When it comes to monsters, we humans tend to\nassume that they will never get along with us, so\nwe fight them, but...
The living beings in this area try their best to\ncoexist by segregating their habitats and not\ninterfering too much in one another's lives...
Although only in Eldenbaum, this area is trying\nto realize the ideal of the Darkan Kingdom that\nhas been kept alive for quite some time...
Oh, wow...
But Captain, don't you think it's a little weird?
You're right. The monsters that dwell in the\nforest aren't supposed to come out to the stone\npath...
Perhaps this is because of those creatures that\nare occupying Eldenbaum...
Oh well, it can't be helped.\nLet's move forward and just drive them off the\npath. Try not to hurt them.
Oh, there you go again...Another herculean task.
